questions.question: When did Nigeria last win the Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON)?
questions.explanation:
Nigeria's Super Eagles have won the Africa Cup of Nations three times: in 1980, 1994, and most recently in 2013. In the 2013 final, they beat Burkina Faso 1-0 in South Africa, thanks to a goal from Sunday Mba.

• Option B (1994) is a trap for their second AFCON title.
• Option C (1980) is their first-ever AFCON title.
• Option D (2023) is a trap for the most recent tournament, where Nigeria were runners-up to Ivory Coast.
